panel.title: MCP Servers
panel.global_description: Configure global MCP servers available in all projects.
panel.claude_scope_note: Turning a server off for Claude also turns it off for the claude CLI in this project. Nimbalyst writes Claude Code's own disabled-server list instead of overriding its configuration.
panel.load_error_description: An unexpected error occurred while loading the MCP servers panel. Please try refreshing the application.
panel.select_or_add: Select a server or click "Add" to create a new one
panel.select_template_description: Choose a template to get started quickly, or create a custom configuration.
panel.start_from_scratch_aria: Start from scratch - Configure all settings manually
panel.oauth_native_hint: This server uses native MCP OAuth. Start a Claude or Codex session and let the client open the browser authorization flow.
panel.oauth_authorized_hint: You are authorized to use this server.
panel.oauth_not_required_hint: This endpoint did not advertise OAuth. Use headers or environment variables if the server requires another auth method.
panel.oauth_login_hint: Select Authorize to open a browser window and sign in.
panel.clear_auth_cache_aria: Clear auth cache and retry authorization
panel.go_to_client_id_aria: Go to the OAuth client ID field
panel.required_credentials_hint: These values are required for the server to connect.
panel.native_oauth_next_step: This settings panel only saves the server configuration. Open a Claude or Codex session and use this server there to start browser authorization.
panel.stdio_hint: Runs a local executable that communicates via stdin/stdout
panel.http_hint: Connects to a remote server using Streamable HTTP (recommended for remote servers)
panel.sse_hint: Connects to a remote server via Server-Sent Events (legacy)
panel.oauth_client_id_placeholder: Only needed if the provider issued you one
panel.oauth_client_id_hint: Leave this empty unless authorization fails because the provider does not support dynamic client registration. Then paste the client ID the provider issued you.
panel.native_oauth_managed_hint: Native MCP OAuth is handled by Claude or Codex the first time the server is used.
panel.oauth_alternative_auth_hint: This endpoint did not advertise OAuth. Use headers or environment variables if the server requires another authentication method.
panel.confirmation_revoke_message: Revoke authorization? You will need to authorize again to use this server.
panel.connection_test_native_oauth: Connection testing is disabled for native MCP OAuth servers. Save the configuration, then open a Claude or Codex session and use the server to authorize it.
panel.config_save_next_step: This panel only saves the server configuration. Open a Claude or Codex session and use this server to start browser authorization.
panel.oauth_native_blocked: This server uses native MCP OAuth. Start a Claude or Codex session and authorize it there instead of using this button.
panel.oauth_native_tokens: Native MCP OAuth tokens are managed by the MCP client. Remove this server from Claude or Codex to authorize it again.
panel.oauth_cache_remote_only: This server uses native MCP OAuth. Auth cache tools only apply to mcp-remote servers.
panel.authorization_failed: Authorization failed. Check the server settings and try again.
panel.authorization_error: Authorization could not be completed. Check the server settings and try again.
panel.revocation_error: Authorization could not be revoked. Try again.
panel.connection_test_failed: The connection test failed. Check the server settings and try again.
panel.figma_oauth_hint: Figma does not allow OAuth-based MCP in some apps. Use the Figma template from the MCP server list instead; it uses a Personal Access Token.

session_status.configured_not_reached: Configured but never reached this session
session_status.scope_description: Reflects the servers Nimbalyst passed to this session. Servers the CLI reads from its own settings may not appear here.

templates.serena: Semantic code retrieval and editing for codebases
